# Scenario: Geopolitical Shock / Supply Chain Disruption

## Trigger
- Major geopolitical conflict escalation (Taiwan Strait, Middle East, South China Sea)
- Critical maritime chokepoint disruption (Strait of Hormuz, Malacca Strait, Suez Canal)
- Sanctions regime significantly expanded (commodity, technology, financial)
- Supply chain fragmentation accelerates (decoupling, friendshoring)

## Transmission Channels

### 1. Energy Channel
- Oil supply disruption (Strait of Hormuz: 21 mbpd transits, 21% of global consumption)
- European gas crisis (if Russia-Ukraine expands or Taiwan disrupts LNG shipping)
- Immediate CPI impact: +2-5pp headline (energy weight in CPI)
- Central bank dilemma: supply shock inflation vs. growth collapse

### 2. Trade / Supply Chain Channel
- Taiwan: TSMC produces 90% of advanced semiconductors → global tech supply chain seizure
- Shipping rates spike (container rates 5-10x, insurance costs explode)
- Just-in-time inventory model breaks again → forced inventory rebuild
- Trade finance freezes for affected regions

### 3. Financial Channel
- Flight to safety: USD, CHF, JPY, gold, Treasuries
- EM sell-off: capital flight from vulnerable EM (CA deficit, low reserves)
- Credit spreads blow out: HY, EM sovereign
- Banking: correspondent banking risk, sanctions compliance panic

### 4. Defense / Fiscal Channel
- NATO/EU defense spending surge (Germany's Zeitenwende 2.0)
- Fiscal expansion for defense → higher bond yields (term premium)
- Defense sector boom: aerospace, cybersecurity, intelligence
- "War economy" supply chain for munitions, drones

## Key Monitoring Triggers
- [ ] US/NATO military posture change (DEFCON, troop movements)
- [ ] Shipping insurance premiums spiking (war risk premiums)
- [ ] Semiconductor export controls tightened (ASML, TSMC restrictions)
- [ ] Oil above $120/bbl sustained for > 2 weeks
- [ ] Taiwan Strait: PLA exercises inside ADIZ / territorial waters
- [ ] Gold > $X (nominal ATH) — risk-off signal confirmation
